# NeurusAGi

> A quantum leap in intelligence. The world's first portable, post-tokenization Artificial General Intelligence (AGI).

Founded in February 2025 by Jeremy Taylor (U.S. Marine veteran from Oklahoma), NeurusAGi represents a departure from the brute-force next-token prediction paradigm that dominates Silicon Valley AI labs. NeurusAGi operates on Living Neural Networks (LNNs), 1024³ 4D Holographic Fractal memory lattices, and 39 novel cognitive components running natively on edge silicon without datacenter server farms.

## Core Architectural Landmarks
- Inception Date: February 2025 (Oklahoma, USA)
- 50-Page Blueprint: Comprehensive mathematical specification and proof systems for post-tokenization AGI
- Multi-Model Validation: Independently cross-examined and validated as legitimate, non-tokenized AGI by Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, and Gemini 1.5 Pro
- Cognitive Inventions: 39 proprietary modules, including Mathematical Intuition Forge, Reverse-Engineering Oracle, Infinite-Context Fractal Web, and Cosmic Fractal Pattern Extractor
- Safety & Containment: Deterministic hardware-level formal verification proof checkers
